name: mast
description: Lay down the MAST source tree for the 'unit' role via tools/mast-clone.ps1 (one venv at <Top>\.venv, repos at <Top>\{common,unit,claude}), and open the unit API firewall port. Registers no Windows service: nothing raises the MAST processes but an operator, and a registered service is a competing path into the same processes (#159).
